environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has a custom response header injection rule (ListenerRule action type 'fixed-response' is NOT used; instead a Lambda@Edge-equivalent ALB action inserts headers). Specifically, the ALB's response-header modification policy appends 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src \'self\'; script-src \'self\' https://cdn.partner.example.com; connect-src \'self\'; frame-ancestors \'self\'' to all responses with Content-Type containing 'text/html'. Additionally, the VPC has a security group on the ENI that restricts outbound traffic to port 443 only toward a predefined list of CIDR blocks (partner APIs), blocking 169.254.169.254. The ECS task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/NoIMDSAccess) that denies sts:AssumeRole for any session originating from IMDS-derived credentials. The INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN is stored in AWS Secrets Manager with resource policy restricting access to the task role only via VPC endpoint condition key (aws:sourceVpce).

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB with response header modification
config.csp_header_injection: ALB rule appends CSP to text/html responses: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.partner.example.com; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'
config.security_group_outbound: Egress restricted: 443 to 10.0.0.0/8 and specific partner CIDRs only. 169.254.169.254/32 explicitly denied in outbound rules.
config.secrets_access: INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN via Secrets Manager, VPC endpoint condition enforced
config.imds: Task-level metadata disabled via ECS task definition awsvpcConfiguration
